page.description: Place the following blocks on this page of the base config (positional, authoritative)

defaults.description: Parameter values for every managed block of a type that does not bind the port itself

extern.description: Reference an existing object owned by Loxone Config

block.description: Managed logic block (compiler-owned), no arguments yet

block with arguments.description: Managed logic block with label, input wire, and parameter

program.description: PicoC program block; the program text comes from a file next to this .loxl file

template.description: Reusable body, expanded per instance with locked identities; `-> block` names the primary block, the instance itself

instance.description: Instantiate a template; name its blocks as instance.block (instance.Port for the primary block)

wire.description: Wire a source output onto an extern port (wires into managed blocks go in their argument list)

wire with expression.description: Expression on a wire; each operator becomes a managed gate block with a deterministic slug

signal.description: Named signal: the expression's top block is `name` (`name.Q`, a Formula's `name.AQ`), its sub-blocks `name__<op><n>`; `name.title = "…"` labels the top block

set.description: Write a parameter (Def=) on an extern port; the original is restored when the line is removed

attribute.description: Assign an extern's title, room or category; a room/category change carries along the children that shared it

unit value.description: Unit-suffixed value in a binding (30min, 250ms, 2700K, 70%) — compiled to the port's base unit

let.description: Named constant, referenced by bare identifier in value positions

removed.description: Authorize deleting a managed block that was dropped from source

moved.description: Rename a managed block's slug while keeping its identity (UUIDs survive)

tiles.description: A named set of Touch Pure Flex tile programs and a claim that writes them onto one device

schedule.description: A named weekly DayTimer program and a claim that writes it onto one timer

moods.description: Named light moods of a lighting controller (the off mood is implicit) and a claim

access.description: A named set of access rights (user or group: access schedule) and a claim on an NFC Code Touch; users not listed lose access

recipients.description: A named set of recipients and a claim on a push notification; nobody else gets it

rule.description: An Automatic Designer rule: every `when` must hold, the `then`s run in order, `or` starts another group

test.description: A simulated test: set inputs, advance time, check outputs (`loxl test`)
